name: Seventeenth-Century Canal Ring Area of Amsterdam inside the Singelgracht
description: Amsterdam's canal ring is a band of curving waterways around the old medieval centre, dug in the early 1600s by draining marshland. The Herengracht, Keizersgracht and Prinsengracht run in concentric arcs, lined with tall gabled merchant houses and old churches. Walking or boating here, you see one of history's largest planned cities, whose design influenced town planning worldwide for two centuries.
